prompt: Write a method that removes every vowel from a string. Complete the removeVowels method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Building a new string one character at a time is a core pattern: a StringBuilder collects the characters you want to keep while a loop examines each one. Lowercasing the character before comparing lets one set of tests handle both cases. Strings are immutable in Java, so you never modify s itself -- you construct a new result.
hints: Loop over s with charAt(i) and decide for each character whether to keep it.
Compare Character.toLowerCase(c) against the five vowel letters so 'A' and 'a' are treated alike.
Append the characters you keep to a StringBuilder and return builder.toString() at the end.
